what.text: This page follows refugees from Estonia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 86 Estonian refugees, and Russia hosted 41.9% of them.
After Russia, the largest hosts are the United States, Sweden and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Estonia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 to 1998 and 2002 to 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 59 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1309, at the end of 1996.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
